Name: Portraited Changing Skies Interiors
Author: aerinanxiety
Description:
[center][/center][center][size=6]Big thanks to Kanadeyoru for [/size][size=6][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23337]Portraited Changing Skies [/url]and putting up with my idiocy as I learned how to do things.[/size]

[size=5][u][color=#f4f4f4]This mod:[/color][/u]
[/size][size=4][b]﻿Adds a few backgrounds for portraits during dialogues as long as Portraited Changing Skies is installed.[/b]
[b]It includes the following:[/b]
Blacksmith
Pierre's 
Museum
Wizard's
Saloon
Joja
[color=#f4f4f4]
I'm currently working on/planning to work on:[/color]
Harvey's Clinic
Marnie's Shop
Robin's Shop
Community Center
[/size][b][size=5][u]
Installing:
[/u][/size][color=#ffff00][size=4]++ This is only set up at the moment for Earthy and Vanilla version of PCS ++﻿[/size][/color]
[size=4]Unzip the .rar into your Mods folder, allow it to overwrite Portraited Changing Skies' content.json.

[/size][size=3]While this addition to PCS' content has been released, it's on the backburner for a bit while I tighten up my UI.[/size][/b][/center]
